fields.why: This is a health-department field investigation of a cluster of medication errors (63 patients found through invoices, the injection log and surveillance search), plus a CDC survey of program areas. It is neither a disease outbreak nor a small case series; the brief needs a rule such as 'field investigations of iatrogenic or adverse-event clusters count as outbreak investigation'.

brief_issues: No study_design value fits investigations of medication errors or adverse-event clusters; add a rule or a 'field investigation' value. A's data_focus has empty ev.
